summary: Pin coherence break after orchestrator leader swap causes silent fallback to degraded variant
description:
Issue summary:
Customer (MapleCloud, Dedicated) reports an increase in mixed-model responses for a pinned route after an orchestrator leader election during a staged canary. The route had been explicitly pinned to redwood-open-v2-13b for a customer cohort; several requests returned the degraded variant (redwood-quant-13b) without an explicit fallback logged in the tenant's debug traces.

Impact:
- Customer experiencing ~8% of requests returning outputs from a different model variant for ~45 minutes.
- Affects production traffic for a high-volume endpoint (billing-sensitive).
- Customer reported quality regressions and alerted their SRE + our support.

Environment:
- prod, us-west-2 region, dedicated capacity pool (dc-aws-usw2-03).
- Route: /v1/generate pin: "tenant:maplecloud:route:billing-invoice-summarize" pinned_version: redwood-open-v2-13b

Steps to reproduce (customer-provided):
1) Traffic against pinned route with sustained canary weight changes (10%->40%->10%) as part of their deployment window.
2) Orchestrator leader swap happened during the 40% window (they observed a control-plane blip and a brief leader re-election).
3) After leader swap, some users' sessions returned outputs with tokenization/format changes consistent with redwood-quant-13b.

Observed logs and evidence:
- Edge traces (MapleCloud tenant debug) show initial request carrying pin cookie and header X-RD-Pin: redwood-open-v2-13b but downstream routed to serving instance labeled redwood-quant-13b-POOL.
- Orchestrator logs show a snapshot commit and a leader promotion at 2026-03-12T14:21:03Z.
- Control-plane snapshot IDs: before swap snap-20260312-1409, after swap snap-20260312-1421.
- No explicit fallback event recorded in tenant-level fallback log; edge proxy logs show a small number of 502 retries contemporaneous with leader swap.
- Customer provided deterministic example request IDs: req-Maple-87921 and req-Maple-87942.

Immediate customer ask:
- Why did pinned requests route to a different variant without a fallback reason?
- Are tokens billed correctly when variants mismatch?
- Request for mitigation to prevent recurrence during leader elections.
comments: 2026-03-12 14:55 - Maya Alvarez (Support): Logged initial ticket and requested full request traces and sample request IDs from customer.
2026-03-12 15:10 - Customer (MapleCloud SRE): Provided edge traces and pointed to orchestrator metric spike at 2026-03-12T14:20:50Z.
2026-03-12 15:35 - Liam O'Connor (SRE): Reproduced leader election in staging and observed control-plane snapshot commit window where pin state could be temporarily inconsistent across shards.
2026-03-12 16:20 - Eng (runtime): Noted edge retry 502s triggered a scaled-down fast-path that bypasses the full pin reconciliation check under specific retry-code paths.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: During orchestrator leader swap we observe a three-way timing window: (1) new snapshot published, (2) edge shards refresh routing metadata, (3) serving pool instances reconcile pin leases. If an edge shard receives a retry-triggered fast-path (502->retry) during this window it may route using cached fallback rules instead of the freshly committed snapshot, causing silent routing to a compatible quantized variant. Supporting evidence: 1) Repro in staging where leader election + induced 502s produced the same silent variant mix; 2) trace alignment between leader_promotion events and first misrouted request. Additional possible contributor: pin-lease refresh TTL was 5s; leader swap introduced an extra 2-3s delay in reconciling TTLs across shards.
resolution_notes:
Short-term mitigation applied 2026-03-12T17:10Z: increased pin-lease grace window from 2s to 8s and disabled retry fast-path routing that bypasses full pin reconciliation for the next 48 hours in us-west-2. Customer confirmed reduction in misrouted responses to <0.1% in subsequent hour.

Planned long-term fix:
- Orchestrator: make snapshot publication atomic with pin-coherence handshake (PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/orchestrator/pull/2784) to prevent any edge shard from seeing a partial commit.
- Edge: ensure retry paths re-run pin validation after transient 5xxs before selecting fallback variant.
- Add a canary test that injects leader-election during staged weight adjustments and validates zero silent-fallbacks for pinned routes.

Rollout notes:
- Patch will be rolled to staging canary 2026-03-14 then to prod us-west-2 on 2026-03-17 outside business hours. A post-deploy smoke will be run against MapleCloud route to verify pin coherence.
suggested_followups:
- Coordinate with Customer Success to update MapleCloud on permanent fix schedule and billing reconciliation if needed.
- Create a short runbook for SRE to follow if similar incidents occur during orchestrator maintenance windows.
- Owner: Liam O'Connor (SRE) for rollout; Eng owner for PR: Priya Nair.
notes_for_billing_team: Customer asked whether tokens billed to the pinned model or the variant that answered. Preliminary answer: billing is recorded by model instance handling the request (we will provide corrected billing report if any discrepancies are found after final audit). Finance contact: billing+support@redwood.com.

2) Extend edge retry validation - target 2026-03-15.
3) Notify MapleCloud of planned prod deploy 2026-03-17 and schedule a joint verification window.
